VARTUL BAANIYA ServiceNow Developer

Bangalore, India | +91 9310337457 | baaniyavartul97@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/vartul-baaniya

SUMMARY

ServiceNow Developer with 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing ITSM, ITOM, and CSM solutions on the ServiceNow platform. Proficient across core ITIL modules including Incident, Change, Problem, and Request Management, Service Catalog, and CMDB/CSDM data foundations. Hands-on expertise in Client Scripts, Business Rules, UI Policies, Script Includes, and Flow Designer, with proven experience building Scripted REST APIs and REST Message integrations for inbound and outbound third-party connectivity. Skilled in Transform Maps, Data Sources, Scheduled Jobs, Data Policies, ACLs, SLAs, and Workflows. Now Assist certified, with growing expertise in ServiceNow AI capabilities.

CORE SKILLS

ServiceNow Development: ACLs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Data Policies, Dictionary Overrides, Script Includes, UI Actions, UI Policies, Record Producers, Form Design & Layouts

Integration & Automation: Scripted REST APIs, REST Messages, Flow Designer, Workflows, Transform Maps, Scheduled Jobs, SLAs, Schedules

Platform & Data: CMDB, CSDM, Notifications, Reports & Dashboards

ITSM / CSM Modules: Incident, Problem, Change & Request Management, Service Catalog, Customer Service Management (CSM)

Project Management & Collaboration: Agile Methodology, Jira, Cross-functional Communication & Teamwork

WORK EXPERIENCE

Infosys Limited

Bangalore, India

Technology Analyst

01/2026 – Present

Senior Systems Engineer

01/2025 – 12/2025

Systems Engineer

03/2022 – 12/2024

Configured and customized ITSM and CSM modules across multiple business units, streamlining incident, problem, change, and case management processes to improve service delivery consistency.

Developed and maintained inbound and outbound REST API integrations between ServiceNow and third-party systems, enabling seamless cross-platform data synchronization and reducing manual data entry.

Built and maintained Transform Maps, Notifications, CMDB configurations, and ACLs to support automated data imports, real-time alerts, and role-based access control.

Designed and delivered end-to-end Service Catalog solutions for multiple enterprise customers, including catalog items, record producers, and multi-level approval workflows.

Created a custom Service Portal application with custom widgets enabling real-time ping testing of services directly from the portal interface.

Implemented Client Scripts, Business Rules, and Script Includes to extend platform functionality, enforce business logic, and improve form usability.

Led the migration of legacy workflows to Flow Designer, managing analysis, redesign, and delivery to modernize automation and reduce manual process handling.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering

Maharshi Dayanand University — Haryana, India | 08/2016 – 09/2021

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified System Administrator (CSA) • Certified Application Developer (CAD) • Certified Implementation Specialist – Data Foundations (CMDB and CSDM) • Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM • Micro-Certification: Now Assist
